holdings.name: Ami Organics Ltd

what_changed.text: Acutaas completed the acquisition of Enchem Ami Organics on October 17, 2026, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary.
Sales in the June 2026 quarter dropped to Rs 330 crore from Rs 433 crore in March 2026, with net profit declining to Rs 75 crore from Rs 134 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Ami Organics is the fund's largest single position at 2.52% weight. Its -13.79% 3-month return made it the biggest performance drag, contributing an estimated -0.348% to the fund.

watch.text: Watch the operational integration and financial consolidation of wholly-owned subsidiary Enchem Ami Organics following its acquisition.

holdings.name: Navin Fluorine International Ltd

what_changed.text: The company commissioned its Rs 75 crore debottlenecking facility at Dahej MPP and commenced commercial production and dispatches.
The DGTR recommended extending anti-dumping duties on Chinese HFC imports.
June 2026 quarterly revenue expanded to Rs 1,045 crore with net profit of Rs 243 crore, compared to Rs 725 crore and Rs 117 crore a year earlier.

holdings.why_it_matters: Navin Fluorine is the second-largest holding at 2.50% weight. It delivered a positive 3.00% 3-month return, providing stability within the 11.0% Materials sector allocation.

watch.text: Watch the board meeting on October 30, 2026 to review Q2/H1 FY27 financial results and consider an interim dividend payout.

holdings.name: Karur Vysya Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: The bank revised its MCLR rates upward by 20 bps starting October 22, 2026.
Ramshankar R assumed the role of Chief Operating Officer on October 16, 2026 after Chandrasekaran M S demitted office.

expected.text: Karur Vysya Bank targets 18% to 20% credit growth in FY27, with corporate lending capped at 20%.
Management raised its FY27 margin outlook while noting funding costs remain a risk factor.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 2.41% portfolio weight, Karur Vysya Bank was the fund's top financial contributor, posting a +5.85% 3-month return that contributed an estimated +0.141%.

watch.text: Watch whether funding costs compress net interest margins despite management's raised FY27 margin outlook.
Watch the loan book response to the 20 bps hike in marginal cost of funds based lending rates.

holdings.name: City Union Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Tamil Nadu GST authorities reduced the tax demand for FY22 to Rs 208.91 crore from Rs 337.79 crore.
The bank opened a new branch at Zoho Corporation, bringing its network to 1,002 branches.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 1.89% weight, the bank gained 2.16% over 3 months, offering mild positive support within the fund's 17.4% allocation to Financials.

watch.text: Watch the board meeting on October 28, 2026 convened to approve unaudited results for Q2 and H1 FY27.

holdings.name: Caplin Point Laboratories Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 quarterly revenue increased to Rs 610 crore with net profit of Rs 179 crore, up from Rs 510 crore and Rs 151 crore respectively in June 2025.
The company clarified to stock exchanges that recent spikes in share trading volume were entirely market-driven with no undisclosed material information.

holdings.why_it_matters: Weighing 1.87% of the fund, the stock dropped -10.51% over 3 months, deducting an estimated -0.197% from fund returns as part of the bottom five contributors.

watch.text: Watch trading volume patterns and delivery data following the company's exchange clarification.

holdings.name: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: The bank approved a preferential issue of up to 6.32 crore shares to raise approximately Rs 409.04 crore from IFC and three insurance companies.
An Extraordinary General Meeting has been called for November 13, 2026 to obtain shareholder approval for the capital raise.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 1.86% weight, Ujjivan SFB fell -7.07% over 3 months, partially offsetting the gains produced by Karur Vysya Bank and City Union Bank in the financials basket.

watch.text: Watch the shareholder vote and regulatory clearance for the Rs 409.04 crore preferential allotment at the November 13, 2026 EGM.

holdings.name: Marksans Pharma Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 net profit rose to Rs 159 crore on sales of Rs 841 crore, up from Rs 58 crore net profit on sales of Rs 620 crore in June 2025.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 1.83% fund weight, Marksans was the portfolio's top 3-month contributor (+0.435%), posting a 23.79% quarterly return against broader weakness in healthcare peers.

watch.text: Watch the board meeting on November 4, 2026 scheduled to declare unaudited financial results for Q2 and H1 FY26.

holdings.name: The Great Eastern Shipping Company Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 quarterly revenue reached Rs 2,005 crore with net profit of Rs 1,309 crore and operating margin rising to 67%.
The company conducted daily open-market equity share buybacks in mid-October 2026, including 1,83,000 shares repurchased at Rs 1,526.10 on October 15.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 1.81% of the fund in Energy & Utilities, the company gained +4.65% over 3 months, aided by company share buybacks and robust operating margins.

watch.text: Watch daily buyback reports to assess the total capital deployed and remaining capacity under the repurchase authorization.

holdings.name: Affle (India) Ltd

what_changed.text: The Supreme Court granted a stay order on Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process proceedings involving Bobble before the NCLT.
Promoter Affle Holdings Pte. Ltd. remitted USD 34.99 million to exercise warrants, resulting in equity share allotments in October 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 1.71% weight within the 18.9% Industrials allocation, Affle declined -6.87% over 3 months and -25.78% over 1 year, acting as an ongoing performance drag.

watch.text: Watch judicial proceedings in the Supreme Court regarding Bobble's insolvency stay order.

holdings.name: Aster DM Healthcare Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 net profit fell sharply to Rs 29 crore from Rs 154 crore in March 2026 and Rs 94 crore in June 2025.
The company reported at its 18th AGM that its merger took effect on July 1, with FY26 revenue at Rs 9,273 crore.
Aster DM and other private hospital operators experienced heavy selling pressure in October.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 1.71% weight, Aster DM lost -18.67% over 3 months, resulting in an estimated -0.319% drag on fund returns (second-largest negative contributor).

watch.text: Watch integration milestones and operational bed expansions following the July 1 merger implementation.

portfolio.statement: The portfolio fell -4.60% over 3 months, driven by severe performance dispersion within its 18.3% Healthcare allocation.
interp: Healthcare performance diverged sharply: Marksans Pharma rose +23.79% (+0.435% contrib), while Ami Organics (-0.348% contrib) and Aster DM (-0.319% contrib) dragged returns down.
Financials (17.4% weight) provided stability via Karur Vysya Bank (+5.85% return), offsetting minor pullbacks in Ujjivan Small Finance Bank.
portfolio.line: Sharp stock-level divergence within Healthcare dominated fund results, pulling 3-month performance negative despite gains in regional banking.

drivers.text: Marksans Pharma rallied +23.79% on sustained operating profit expansion, providing the fund's top 3-month contribution (+0.435%).
Sharp quarterly net profit declines at Aster DM Healthcare and sequential sales drop at Ami Organics led to 3-month declines of -18.67% and -13.79% respectively.
Karur Vysya Bank gained +5.85% over 3 months, backed by an upgraded FY27 margin outlook and an 18-20% credit growth target.

themes.title: Healthcare Performance Divergence
themes.text: Within the fund's 18.3% Healthcare basket, export formulation businesses outperformed, whereas hospital chains and API specialists saw sharp profitability and share price pullbacks.

themes.title: Lending Rates and Capital Expansion
themes.text: Financial holdings (17.4% weight) focused on margin protection through MCLR adjustments and capital additions to support balance sheet expansion.

macro.why: Karur Vysya Bank revised MCLR rates upward by 20 bps to protect margins amid rising cost of funds while pursuing 18-20% credit growth.
The DGTR recommended extending anti-dumping duty on Chinese HFC imports, directly affecting competitive positioning in fluorochemicals.

priced_in.text: Karur Vysya Bank's raised FY27 margin guidance and 18-20% credit growth target have been absorbed after the stock hit all-time highs.
Ujjivan Small Finance Bank's planned Rs 409.04 crore capital raise from IFC and insurers is recognized prior to the November EGM.

could_change.title: Hospital Margin and Bed Additions
could_change.text: If Aster DM Healthcare's post-merger integration drives earnings recovery toward broker bed addition targets, the healthcare drag could abate.

could_change.title: Deposit Pricing Pressure on SFBs
could_change.text: If deposit competition intensifies, Ujjivan Small Finance Bank could face net interest margin compression despite fresh Tier-1 capital.

portfolio.risk_note: UTI Small Cap Fund exhibits high stock-specific volatility (17.29% annualized standard deviation) and a beta of 1.08 against small-cap benchmarks. High-multiple holdings such as Aster DM Healthcare (P/E 160.38) and Ami Organics (P/E 68.80) amplify portfolio sensitivity to quarterly earnings misses.
